union all select 'rxt', min(wk_end_dt), max(wk_end_dt), count(distinct wk_end_dt), count(distinct dayname(wk_end_dt)), listagg(distinct dayname(wk_end_dt), ',') from PHARMA_DEMO.RAW_3P.RXT_WKLY
union all select 'clm', min(clm_dt), max(clm_dt), count(*), count(distinct abndn_flg), listagg(distinct abndn_flg, ',') from PHARMA_DEMO.RAW_3P.CLMLNS_ADJ
select prod_ndc11, length(prod_ndc11) l, count(*) n, sum(iff(abndn_flg='Y',1,0)) ab, count(distinct pat_key) pats from PHARMA_DEMO.RAW_3P.PATHPT_LVL group by 1,2 order by 1

select count(*) n, count(distinct pat_key||clm_dt||prod_ndc11||prscrbr_me||plan_id) dist, sum(iff(p.prscrbr_me is null,1,0)) no_presc_match, sum(iff(p.terr_id is null,1,0)) no_terr, sum(iff(t.terr_id is null,1,0)) no_terr_match
from PHARMA_DEMO.RAW_3P.PATHPT_LVL x left join PHARMA_DEMO.CORE.PRESCRIBER p on p.prscrbr_me=x.prscrbr_me left join PHARMA_DEMO.CORE.TERRITORY t on t.terr_id=p.terr_id
where x.prod_ndc11 like '%9910101%' or x.prod_ndc11 in ('99101010105','99101010110')

sql.sql:
select count(*) n, count(distinct x.pat_key||x.clm_dt||x.prod_ndc11||x.prscrbr_me||x.plan_id) dist, sum(iff(p.prscrbr_me is null,1,0)) no_presc_match, sum(iff(p.terr_id is null,1,0)) no_terr, sum(iff(t.terr_id is null,1,0)) no_terr_match
from PHARMA_DEMO.RAW_3P.PATHPT_LVL x left join PHARMA_DEMO.CORE.PRESCRIBER p on p.prscrbr_me=x.prscrbr_me left join PHARMA_DEMO.CORE.TERRITORY t on t.terr_id=p.terr_id
where x.prod_ndc11 in ('99101010105','99101010110') and x.clm_dt between '2026-06-27' and '2026-09-25'
select t.*, (select count(*) from PHARMA_DEMO.CORE.PRESCRIBER p where p.terr_id=t.terr_id) n_presc from PHARMA_DEMO.CORE.TERRITORY t order by 1

with x as (
 select p.terr_id, x.pat_key, x.abndn_flg, x.clm_dt
 from PHARMA_DEMO.RAW_3P.PATHPT_LVL x join PHARMA_DEMO.CORE.PRESCRIBER p on p.prscrbr_me=x.prscrbr_me
 where x.prod_ndc11 in ('99101010105','99101010110') and x.clm_dt between '2026-06-27' and '2026-09-25')
select t.district_id, t.terr_id, t.terr_nm, count(*) rx_claims, sum(iff(abndn_flg='Y',1,0)) abandoned, count(distinct pat_key) pats,
 round(100*sum(iff(abndn_flg='Y',1,0))/count(*),1) abn_pct,
 round(100*sum(iff(abndn_flg='Y' and clm_dt>='2026-08-08',1,0))/nullif(sum(iff(clm_dt>='2026-08-08',1,0)),0),1) abn_pct_last7wk_approx
from PHARMA_DEMO.CORE.TERRITORY t left join x on x.terr_id=t.terr_id
group by 1,2,3 order by 1,2

select 'claims' src, adj_stat, count(*) n, sum(iff(abndn_flg='Y',1,0)) ab, round(100*ab/n,1) pct
from PHARMA_DEMO.RAW_3P.CLMLNS_ADJ where prod_ndc11 in ('99101010105','99101010110') and clm_dt between '2026-06-27' and '2026-09-25' group by 1,2
union all
select 'pathpt_district_'||t.district_id, null, count(*), sum(iff(abndn_flg='Y',1,0)), round(100*sum(iff(abndn_flg='Y',1,0))/count(*),1)
from PHARMA_DEMO.RAW_3P.PATHPT_LVL x join PHARMA_DEMO.CORE.PRESCRIBER p on p.prscrbr_me=x.prscrbr_me join PHARMA_DEMO.CORE.TERRITORY t on t.terr_id=p.terr_id
where x.prod_ndc11 in ('99101010105','99101010110') and x.clm_dt between '2026-06-27' and '2026-09-25' group by rollup(t.district_id)
order by 1,2

select p.terr_id,
 sum(iff(x.clm_dt>='2026-06-27',1,0)) n_cur, round(100*sum(iff(x.clm_dt>='2026-06-27' and abndn_flg='Y',1,0))/nullif(n_cur,0),1) pct_cur,
 sum(iff(x.clm_dt<'2026-06-27',1,0)) n_prior, round(100*sum(iff(x.clm_dt<'2026-06-27' and abndn_flg='Y',1,0))/nullif(n_prior,0),1) pct_prior
from PHARMA_DEMO.RAW_3P.PATHPT_LVL x join PHARMA_DEMO.CORE.PRESCRIBER p on p.prscrbr_me=x.prscrbr_me
where x.prod_ndc11 in ('99101010105','99101010110') and x.clm_dt between '2026-03-28' and '2026-09-25'
group by rollup(p.terr_id) order by 1
